summary: Verified FAQ category linkage bug fix end-to-end. Backend GET /api/faq?category=reservar|politicas returns correctly seeded/categorized items; admin FAQ CRUD honours the new `category` field. On the frontend, admin FAQ modal exposes the 3-option `faq-category` select with labels ¿Cómo reservar?/Políticas de viaje/General; edits made in admin now propagate live to /lo-que-debes-saber → ¿Cómo reservar? and → Políticas de viaje tabs (previous bug fixed). Regression checks on other FAQ tabs (seguro, cancelacion) and other admin tabs (Viajes, Reservas, Galería, Videos, Testimonios) also pass with no errors.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminFAQ.jsx (line 44): interpolates {CATEGORY_LABELS[f.category] || f.category} — works, but consider using shared constants module rather than duplicating labels between backend seed strings, AdminFAQ, and FAQ.jsx.

backend/server.py migrate_faq_categories: idempotent guard uses `count_documents({category:'reservar'}) == 0` — safe for now, but if admin later deletes all reservar FAQs they will be silently re-seeded on next restart. Consider a one-time flag document instead.
FAQ.jsx CmsFaqList returns null when faqs empty (line 252) — for admins who delete all category items this will hide the whole section silently on the public page. Consider a friendly empty state.
AdminFAQ.jsx uses window.confirm for delete; consider a proper confirmation dialog for consistency with other admin sections.
seed_data_creation: Backend startup seeds 5 'reservar' + 6 'politicas' FAQs via migrate_faq_categories(). No manual seed needed. Test FAQ 'Pregunta de prueba QA' was created and cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FAQ category feature is fully working. Any future edit in admin FAQ that keeps category='reservar' or 'politicas' will show live on /lo-que-debes-saber under the corresponding tab. Accordion answer content is always in the DOM (CSS-collapsed), so text_content of cms-faq-{category} container includes both question and answer strings.
rca of the issue: Original bug: FAQ.jsx used hardcoded question arrays fuzzy-matched against /api/faq answers, causing admin edits to never reflect publicly. Fix (validated): (a) added `category` field to FAQItem/FAQInput models with default 'general'; (b) GET /api/faq accepts ?category= filter; (c) migrate_faq_categories() seeds proper reservar/politicas FAQs on startup; (d) CmsFaqList in FAQ.jsx now fetches /faq?category=X and renders live DB question/answer directly. Verified via pytest CRUD + Playwright end-to-end edit→public visibility.
